mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, condition_field_name, api_url, request_method, param, select_label, select_value, select_disabled, search_key_field, api_type, field_type, is_required, bussiness_key, condition_field, field_belongs_type, logic,controls,parent_id,class_path,is_extend,value_type,use_type
mapper.select: SELECT condition_field, condition_field_name, request_method, controls, api_url, param, select_label as label, select_value as value, search_key_field as searchKey, select_value as remoteLabel, value_type as valueType FROM cfg_query_option WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND bussiness_key = #{businessKey}

SELECT condition_field, concat(case when field_belongs_type = 'table' then '单据头-' else '单据明细-' end, condition_field_name) AS condition_field_name, request_method, controls, api_url, param, api_type, select_label, select_value, search_key_field, select_value, field_type, is_required, logic, field_belongs_type, bussiness_key FROM cfg_query_option WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND bussiness_key = #{businessKey}

SELECT id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, condition_field_name, api_url, request_method, param, select_label, select_value, select_disabled, search_key_field, api_type, field_type, is_required, bussiness_key, condition_field, field_belongs_type, logic,controls,parent_id,class_path,is_extend,value_type,use_type FROM cfg_query_option WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND bussiness_key IN ( SELECT bussiness_key FROM cfg_query_option WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND TABLE_NAME = #{params.tableName} AND sys_classify = #{params.sysClassify} LIMIT 1 )
